holderQuote: Ishkr’s a private guy. He’s probably super-embarrassed.
effectQuote: He’s got a few more cool Skills too. I think he gets them every time he meets a weird guest.

holderQuote: [Magic-Piercing Throw]. And [Avoid Danger: Inn]. Those two tend to keep me out of trouble even if there’s a failsafe.
effectQuote: If it’s enchanted, I throw a rock at it. Or a spoon. It breaks the enchantment or sometimes destroys the document.
